pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped, sub-polygonal patches with predominantly smooth-to-blurry pixel gradients at the edges. Patch size is largest on the upper flank and becomes progressively smaller and more fragmented toward the posterior and ventral regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of off-white interstitial spaces. Junction nodes are mostly three-way intersections. The pixel thickness of the pathways is relatively uniform, creating a defined grid-like separation between patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The dorsal mane exhibits a dense, low-amplitude serrated silhouette against the background. The frequency of the jagged peaks is high and regular along the visible portion of the upper neck.

other_distinctive_markers: Two birds are perched on the upper neck and shoulder area, partially occluding the dorsal ridge profile at those specific pixel locations.
